definitions.short: a winnowing shovel (as scattering the chaff)
definitions.full: H4214. mizreh מִזְרֶה noun [masculine] pitch-fork , with six prongs (= ) used in winnowing, compare Wetzst ZPV 1891, xiv. 2 ; for winnowing provender וּבְמ בָרַחַת ׳זֹרֶה Isa 30:24 ; figurative for winnowing, i.e. chastising the people בְּמ ׳וָאֶזְרֵם Jer 15:7 .
